limitations: This is an obstruction, not a type-(iv) exclusion.
Moving-junction/core variations and topology changes other than cap extinction were not covered.
Cap extinction recovers the frozen threshold cap-replacement method.
summary: For the fixed-core, fixed-junction two-cap redistribution class, the symmetric type-(iv) cap pair is the unique nondegenerate perimeter minimum at fixed total cap area, including major-cap redistributions.
